messages:
Aisha (CS): Quick sync — BrightQuill private deploy started week1. Looping in networking/security for KMS/IAM/audit gaps before prod cutover. Customer requested 365d audit retention and quarterly KMS rotation evidence. Any blockers?
Liam (CSE): Ran the preflight. Network CIDR allocated 10.20.0.0/22 but customer asked for an extra /28 for management plane. Need confirmation on NAT and egress path to Splunk ingestion.
Priya (SRE): Need their subnet map. BrightQuill wants split egress: Splunk via VPC peering, other traffic via NAT gateway. Peering requires a route on BrightQuill side; asked them to open TCP/4503 -> splunk.company.net.
Rohit (Security): KMS approach: customer-managed CMK in their AWS account with cross-account usage from Redwood. We'll provide a key policy template and KMS grant flow. For retention evidence: CloudTrail -> S3 with 365d lifecycle and a signed extract of rotation events.
Aisha (CS): @Rohit can you paste the recommended trust/key policy snippet so I can send to BrightQuill SecOps?
Rohit (Security): Sample key policy (replace ARNs):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::BRIGHT:role/RedwoodKMSUser"},
      "Action": "kms:*",
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
Enable automatic rotation and add CloudTrail lookup permissions for the Redwood audit role.
NetworkBot: Route table RTB-08 applied to subnet-priv-01, NAT gateway ngw-03 created (us-east-1b) :white_check_mark: 
Liam (CSE): Note: their IAM needs a cross-account role named RedwoodProvisioner with scoped permissions (sts:AssumeRole + s3:PutObject to a specific prefix). Example assume-role policy to share:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD:role/infra-deploy"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```
Jenna (Account Exec): Heads-up: renewal is ~90 days out. This deployment is a high-priority expansion opportunity. If we meet SLA & observability by week2 I can negotiate +25% commit on renewal. Risk: delayed audit evidence could slow the contract.
Aisha (CS): Action items: 1) @Priya confirm peering route status 2) @Rohit finalize key policy + rotation evidence template 3) @Liam validate IAM role trust & S3 prefixes 4) @Jenna flag renewal timeline with legal. I'll consolidate and send to BrightQuill.
Priya (SRE): Confirmed: peering route installed on our side pointing to 10.20.0.0/22 -> peering-bridge. Waiting on BrightQuill to push reciprocal route and their route table ID. Sent them the AWS CLI route command and request for their table id.
Rohit (Security): I'll prepare a rotation evidence package: sample CloudTrail query, exported CSV/PDF, signed statement, and S3 presigned URL (30d). ETA EOD.
Liam (CSE): I'll perform a dry-run of sts:assume-role and s3:PutObject against their test bucket once they share the role ARN. Plan: `aws sts assume-role` then `aws s3 cp` to the provided prefix.
Aisha (CS): Thanks. I'll send a consolidated note to BrightQuill now with these snippets and next steps. If they don't ack peering by EOD tomorrow escalate to TAM. :alarm_clock: 
BrightQuill (Customer): thx, will confirm route table today and share role ARN. one q — can rotation evidence be exported as pdf?
Rohit (Security): Yes — we'll export CloudTrail query results, attach a short signed verification statement, store in S3 and generate a presigned URL for download (30d). :thumbsup: 
OpsBot: Deployment dry-run started at 2024-04-01T15:12:30Z, step 3/6 succeeded (kv cache warmup). Logs: `ingest->ok`, `kv->ok`, `peering-status:pending`
Aisha (CS): Follow-up: sending the doc now. Next sync Tuesday 11am ET. Closing thread once BrightQuill confirms route and ARN. :white_check_mark:
